PLAN "12-Week Strength - Cycle and Flare Adapted"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength while respecting cycle and flare windows"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper - light (flow 2026-06-01)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower - light (flow 2026-06-03)":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
